## 🔴 CRITICAL BLOCKER: Production Deployment Needed

**Status**: BLOCKED - Cannot execute Phase 3 campaigns without public signup link

**Issue**: 
- Current config: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://localhost:3000 (localhost only)
- Needed: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://brolabentertainment.com (production)
- Location: .env.local (line 15)

**Impact**:
- BRO-124 (Twitter/X): Can't share public signup link
- BRO-125 (DM Outreach): Can't send signup link to producers  
- BRO-126 (Reddit): Can't include signup link in comments (THIS TASK)
- BRO-127 (Content Assets): Demo/signup links need production URL

**Action Required**:
- Deploy to https://brolabentertainment.com
- Verify /sign-up and checkout flow work on production URL
- Confirm Clerk/Stripe/Convex are configured for production domain

**Owner**: Lead Engineer (deployment) + CTO (coordinating)

**Timeline**: URGENT - Phase 3 campaign materials ready NOW, waiting for this unblock
